name: Sins We Desire
source:
After surviving a devastating bomb explosion during his service in the Middle East, Lieutenant Ryan Walker returns to his roots in the quiet town of Frostwood. Scarred by the echoes of combat, he seeks nothing more than a place to recover and a chance to reconnect with the life he left behind.

But Frostwood is no longer the peaceful haven he remembers.

Moving into a home shared with Victoria and Amber, Ryan quickly realizes that the tension inside the house is as thick as the mysteries lurking outside. When a series of brutal animal attacks and a mysterious break-in shatter the silence of the night, Ryan must use his military instincts to protect those he cares about.

As you navigate the complex lives of Victoria, Amber, Alexia, and Kaori, you will find yourself entangled in a web of secrets, forbidden desires, and an ancient darkness. You must manage Ryan's relationships carefully—loyalty is fragile, and desire can be a dangerous compass.
